❯ The nightly invoice job failed. Why?

⏺ Bash(grep -c 'status=429' logs/invoice-job-2026-10-05.log)
  ⎿  4100

⏺ Why the nightly invoice job failed

  - The job sends one API call per invoice to the payment provider. Last night
    it had 4,200 invoices; the provider allows 100 calls per minute, so after
    the first 100 calls every call got HTTP 429 (too many requests).
  - The job has no retry, so 4,100 invoices were not sent. Customers will get
    them a day late unless we re-run the job before 9:00.
  - It worked until this week because there were fewer than 100 invoices a
    night; the new annual plans pushed it to 4,200 on the 1st of the month.
  - Proper fix: use the provider's bulk endpoint, which takes 500 invoices per
    call (9 calls for 4,200). About 40 lines.
  - Quick fix: retry with a 1-minute wait; sending all 4,100 would take about
    42 minutes.
  - Re-running now with the quick fix is safe: the provider ignores a duplicate
    invoice id.
